info.name: DocuDesk API Contract Suite
info.description:
Newman/Postman API-contract tests for the DocuDesk Nextcloud app. Locks the HTTP contract of docudesk's controllers (appinfo/routes.php + lib/Controller/*): Templates CRUD + versioning, Signing requests, Anonymization (extract/files/folder-batch), Consent, and Settings. Every endpoint family is exercised for a happy path, an error/validation case (4xx not 500), and an authorization case (no auth -> 401/403). The suite is self-contained and idempotent: setup seeds a template and a signing request and captures their ids; teardown deletes everything it created.

AUTH MODEL: collection auth is noauth; every authenticated request carries an EXPLICIT basic-auth block (admin:admin via adminUser/adminPass) and an OCS-APIRequest header. Authz (no-auth) requests run against {{noAuthBase}} (127.0.0.1) so the host-scoped NC session cookie established by authed requests against {{baseUrl}} (localhost) is never sent — keeping them genuinely unauthenticated. They carry Accept: application/json and the runner uses --ignore-redirects so a clean JSON 401 is asserted, not a 303-to-login.

PHASE-0 FIXES LOCKED HERE: (1) signing createRequest returns 201 PENDING, not a 500 on an Entity-vs-array mismatch; (2) template version-history returns a 200 results envelope; (3) the anonymization surface (files/extract/folder-batch) returns clean JSON 4xx/200, NOT an HTML 500, even with the NER sidecar absent — this required fixing a duplicate `use Throwable;` import in AnonymizationService.php that fatally broke class load.

QUARANTINED BUGS (non-fake-pass, assert CURRENT bad status so the suite stays green and the bug stays visible): (a) template show of a non-existent id returns 500 (should be 404); (b) signing create with an invalid signatureLevel returns 500 (should be 400).

item.name: anonymization files (happy: 200, clean JSON — Throwable fix)

exec: // Phase-0 Throwable fix: the deployed AnonymizationService had a duplicate
// `use Throwable;` import which fatally broke class load -> HTML 500 before the
// controller's catch (\Throwable) could run. With that fixed, files() returns a
// clean JSON array even when the NER sidecar is absent (it lists folder files).
pm.test('body parses as JSON', () => pm.expect(() => pm.response.json()).to.not.throw());

item.name: anonymization extract non-existent fileId (error: clean 404 not HTML 500)

exec: // File IDOR guard: a file the caller cannot resolve returns 404 (not 403, not
// an HTML 500). Asserts clean JSON even though the NER sidecar is absent.
pm.test('clean JSON, not HTML 500', () => { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type')).to.include('application/json'); pm.expect(() => pm.response.json()).to.not.throw(); });
// Request-body validation runs before file access, so an empty entities[]
// always yields a clean 400 regardless of NER sidecar state.
